data: Is the BLEU value for Ke=4 higher than Ke=0 when the size of the AMR graph is between 11-20?

The question asks whether the BLEU value for Ke=4 is higher than Ke=0 when the size of the AMR graph is between 11-20. From the left graph, we can see that the red line (Ke=4) is consistently above the blue line (Ke=0) across all ranges of graph sizes. In the range of 11-20, the red line (Ke=4) is also above the blue line (Ke=0). Therefore, the BLEU value for Ke=4 is indeed higher than Ke=0 when the size of the AMR graph is between 11-20.
